query:
SELECT mf."mediaId"
           FROM media_files mf
           WHERE mf."mediaId" = ANY($1)
           GROUP BY mf."mediaId"
           UNION
           SELECT s."mediaId"
           FROM media_files mf
           JOIN episodes e ON e.id = mf."episodeId"
           JOIN seasons s ON s.id = e."seasonId"
           WHERE s."mediaId" = ANY($1)
           GROUP BY s."mediaId"
